findings.title: Candidate manifest contains an incorrect byte hash
findings.original_wording: candidate/MANIFEST.json declares an all-zero SHA-256 value for malformed.json.

findings.objective_closure_criteria: Reissue the candidate manifest with the exact SHA-256 hash of the frozen malformed.json bytes, then re-run the hash comparison with exit status 0 and exact equality.
